LESSON: GENERAL ETIQUETTE:

Grade: PP2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Sadachar
Topic 6.1: General Etiquette:

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about General Etiquette:. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. mention words that (Good Behaviour) relationship
2. demonstrate acts of obedience to foster harmony
3. appreciate the blessings that may be bestowed upon him/her out of obedience.
